about.heading: Who We Are
about.description: OSR Tours and Travels has been serving the Sindhudurg region since 2010, providing safe, comfortable, and affordable travel solutions.
about.mission: We pride ourselves on our modern fleet, professional drivers, and commitment to customer satisfaction. Our mission is to make travel easy, safe, and enjoyable for everyone.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Comprehensive Travel Solutions
services.cityTransportDesc: Regular local travel connecting Kudal to nearby cities and towns. Frequent schedules and affordable fares for daily commuters.
services.highwayRoutesDesc: Long-distance comfortable journeys on major highways. AC buses with reclining seats for your comfort on extended travels.
services.tourismPackagesDesc: Curated travel packages to popular destinations. Explore Kerala, Goa, and scenic locations with professional guides.
services.corporateTransportDesc: Dedicated travel solutions for companies. Employee shuttle services and group travel arrangements for corporate events.
services.groupTravelDesc: Perfect for educational tours, family outings, and group celebrations. Customized itineraries and competitive group rates.
services.cargoLogisticsDesc: Safe and timely cargo transportation. Covered vehicles with GPS tracking for complete peace of mind.
